critical_code_review_comments: loyalty.on_payment_earn tier-promotion detection is dead code: pay_order() updates member.lifetime_spend BEFORE reading `fresh` doc and calling on_payment_earn. Inside, spend=member_doc['lifetime_spend'] already includes current order, so `tier = tier_for(spend)` and `new_tier = tier_for(spend + order.total)` will only differ if a SECOND threshold is crossed by adding the same total again — effectively never for normal orders. The 'Promoted to X!' award never fires. Suggested fix: read member snapshot BEFORE the lifetime_spend $set in orders.pay_order, then pass pre-spend to on_payment_earn.

Members search endpoint uses raw regex with `$regex: q` — user-supplied strings containing regex metachars (`(`, `[`, `.`, etc.) could throw or return unexpected matches. Not blocking; consider re.escape.

Loyalty.jsx line 77 nextPct math: uses `100 - Math.round((spend_to_next / next_tier.min_spend) * 100)` which is inaccurate — should be relative to (next.min_spend - current_tier.min_spend). E.g., at Bronze with 1200 spent (spend_to_next=3800, next.min_spend=5000) → shows 24% instead of 24% of 5000 range vs Bronze->Silver range. Cosmetic but misleading progress bar.
Loyalty spin cooldown check uses last_spin_at ISO parse; if malformed the code silently allows spin. Low risk.
